verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently, but two dark days broke delivery.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 30 leads from Meta at a cost of $46.95 per lead, and the most recent 7-day window showed cost per lead drop 50% even as spend fell — a sign the August Re-Launch campaign is finding its footing. That progress was interrupted on September 9–10, when Meta ran no ads and delivered zero leads both days; this was a delivery disruption, not a slow market. Ads are back running and delivery is being monitored daily to prevent another gap. Separately, 24 contacts reached your pipeline this period but none have been logged as active opportunities, which points to an intake step that needs tightening — that is being addressed alongside the CRM setup already in progress.

highlights.phrase: leads received from paid ads in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period, with the most recent week running 50% below that
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, clicks, and map interactions

watch_item.issue: Two zero-spend days on September 9–10 broke delivery mid-week and erased recent efficiency gains.
watch_item.fix: Ad delivery has been restored and is under daily watch to ensure no further gaps in spend or lead flow.
